content.hebrew: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai.

content.hebrew: *מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: *Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai. (Proverbs 18:22)

content.hebrew: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִפְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽהּ:
content.transliteration: Eshet ḥayil mi yimtsa, veraḥoḳ mippeninim michrah.
content.english: A woman of valor who can find? For her price is far above rubies. (Proverbs 31:10)

content.hebrew: *מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: *Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai.

content.hebrew: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֝הֹו֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל:
content.transliteration: Sheḳer haḥen vehevel hayyofi, ish-sha yirat adonai hi tit-hallal.
content.english: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman that fears Adonai, she shall be praised. (Proverbs 31:30)

content.hebrew: *מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: *Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai.

content.hebrew: תְּנוּ־לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ, וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ:
content.transliteration: Tenu lah mipperi yadeha, vihaleluha vash-she‘arim ma‘aseha.
content.english: Give her the fruit of her hands; and let her works praise her in the gates. (Proverbs 31:31)

content.hebrew: *מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: *Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai.

content.transliteration: Umtsa ḥen vesechel tov, be‘ené elohim ve’adam.
content.english: So shall you find grace and good favor in the eyes of God and man. (Proverbs 3:4)

content.hebrew: *מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: *Matsa ish-sha matsa tov, vayyafeḳ ratson me’adonai.
content.english: He who finds a wife finds a great good and obtains the favor of Adonai.
